turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
Removal is the hardest part of a job to predict without seeing the wall — modern strippable papers can come off cleanly, while older or painted-over layers can be slow and sometimes reveal repair work underneath. That's usually why it gets looked at in person rather than guessed at.

If you'd like, I can pass along your details so someone can take a look when you're ready — or just keep browsing, no rush.
